The '''CY-M sword''' was a weapon used by [[CY-M Prototype]]s.

{{Weapon-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The CY-M sword appeared in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a massively multiplayer online roleplaying game developed by [[Sony]] and published by [[LucasArts]], prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].
